Native macOS menu bar speech-to-text app via Groq API: hold hotkey, speak, release; text appears. macOS 13+, Apple Silicon; Swift 5.0, SwiftUI.
Create a feature branch before making changes: `git checkout -b feature/<name>`
After Swift file changes, always run:
xcodebuild -project whisperswift.xcodeproj -scheme whisperswift -configuration Debug build
Tests: xcodebuild test -project whisperswift.xcodeproj -scheme whisperswift -destination 'platform=macOS'
./scripts/build-with-timing.sh
./scripts/check-duplicates.sh
./scripts/generate-docs.sh
Sandbox disabled; required for global hotkeys and accessibility API. Carefully edit `whisperswift/whisperswift.entitlements`. Logs: `/tmp/whisperswift.log`
Read relevant docs first: codebase `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`; build `docs/BUILD_PERFORMANCE.md`; feature flags `docs/feature-flags/FEATURE_FLAGS.md`; style `docs/CODE_STYLE.md`; observability `docs/OBSERVABILITY.md`; CI/CD `docs/CI_CD.md`; release `docs/RELEASE_BUILD.md`; alerting `docs/alerting/ALERTING.md`.
